{{Top|leg}}
The '''Blue Petal Bar''' was located on a floating platform in the courtyard of the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino|Holiday Towers]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It served excellent drinks and hosted obscure [[Musician/Legends|musicians]].
